title: ALWIDA ALWIDA
body:
Aaj har ek Azadare Shabbir ke
Hai labo'n par fugha'n Alwida Alwida
Aa rahi hai harek simt se ye sada
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Dojaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Ronagein ab gharo'n se chali jaaengi
Fatima Bhi yaha'n ab nahi Aaengi
Har taraf ek udaasi si chhaa jaaegi
Roenge mezba'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Tukde tukde Pidar ka kaleja hua
Rann me paamaal Bete ka Laasha hua
Aye Yateeme Hasan Naoshahe Karbala
Qasime Khasta jaa'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Deene Ahmed ka seena sipar jo hua
Tere seene me barchhi ka phal reh gaya
LaashTeri Shahe Dee'n se uth na saki
Akbare Naojawa'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer se pyaas Teri bujhaai gayi
Pushte khaima lahad jab banaayi gayi
Khod kar qabr kaata gaya sar Tera
Asghare bezaban Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Tera Noke Naiza se girta raha
Aur ghode ki gardan me bandha gaya
Tere marne ne Sheh ki kamar tod di
Aye Ali ke Nashaa'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu har ek gaam par qatl hota raha
Be ridaai pa kunbe ki rota raha
Tauqo zanjeer Tujh ko pinhaai gayi
Abid e Naatawa'n Al Wida Al Wida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Daamane Sabr Tujh se na chhoota kabhi
Tu ne Bachcho'n ko Apne na roya kabhi
Binte Zehra aye Aun o Muhammad ki Maa
Tujh siMaadar kaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad qatle Pidar har sitam Sehgayi
Hasrate Dil Liye qaid me Margayi
Lo Utho ja raha hai watan karwa'n
Sheh ki aaraame jaan Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Lamhaye rukhsate mehma'n aagaya
Haq ada mezbaani ka ho na saka
Leke aankhon me ashke aqeedat kaho
Aye Lute Karwa'n Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun na ab ho Ageel ek mehshar bapa
Hamse hote hain rukhsat Shah-e-Karbala
Keh rahe hain Shahinshaahe Kauno Maka'n
Aye Mere mezbaan Alwida Alwida
<<MINI>>
Aye Shahe Do jaha'n Alwida Alwida
author: Mir Ashraf Ali Aqeel
